name: Baseline
description: The standard RT-DETR model with a ResNet-18vd backbone, serving as the performance reference for all experiments. Uses the original AIFI-based encoder with 3 CCFM stages (P3-P5 feature levels) and 3 decoder layers with 300 queries. Trained on VisDrone for 101 epochs.

name: Final Improved Gnconv
description: RT-DETR with the original ResNet-18vd backbone, extended with a P2 feature level alongside P3-P5. All feature extraction blocks (P2-P5) in the CCFM encoder use an improved GnConv that replaces the recursive loops of standard GnConv with parallel horizontal/vertical pooling and multiplicative gating for better efficiency. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries. Trained on VisDrone for 101 epochs.

name: Final Efficientnet-B2 + GnConv + P2
description: RT-DETR variant replacing the ResNet-18vd backbone with EfficientNet-B2, combined with a GnConv-based encoder and an additional P2 feature level for improved small object detection. The EfficientNet-B2 backbone reduces parameter count while the GnConv blocks replace standard convolutions in the CCFM encoder. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries. Trained on VisDrone for 101 epochs.

name: GnConv + P2 Layer
description: RT-DETR with the original ResNet-18vd backbone and a standard RepVGG-based CCFM encoder (P3-P5). Enhances small object detection by adding a P2 feature level whose feature extraction block uses GnConv (Gated Network Convolution) instead of RepVGG. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries. Trained on VisDrone for 101 epochs.

name: GnConv + SLIM P2 Layer
description: RT-DETR with the original ResNet-18vd backbone and a standard RepVGG-based CCFM encoder (P3-P5). Similar to GnConv + P2, but the P2 feature extraction block uses a slimmed-down GnConv design with 128 channels to lower computational cost while still providing high-resolution small object features. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries. Trained on VisDrone for 101 epochs.

name: P2 Layer
description: RT-DETR with the original ResNet-18vd backbone and a standard RepVGG-based CCFM encoder (P3-P5). Adds a P2 feature level with a standard RepVGG-based feature extraction block, providing higher-resolution feature maps to the decoder for better small object detection. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries. Trained on VisDrone for 101 epochs.

name: Final Query Improvement
description: RT-DETR with the original ResNet-18vd backbone and standard encoder (P3-P5), with modifications to the decoder query mechanism. Increases num_queries to 500 and introduces scale-aware query selection that allocates queries proportionally across feature levels (40% from P3, 30% from P4, 30% from P5), biasing detection toward smaller objects captured at higher-resolution P3 features. Uses 3 decoder layers. Trained on VisDrone for 101 epochs.

name: Slim P2 Layer
description: RT-DETR with the original ResNet-18vd backbone and a standard RepVGG-based CCFM encoder (P3-P5). Adds a slimmed-down P2 feature level with 128 channels (reduced from the standard 256) using a RepVGG-based block, providing higher-resolution small object features at lower computational cost. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries. Trained on VisDrone for 101 epochs.

name: (gnConV+p2)
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant featuring a GnConv-based P2 layer for improved small object detection. Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone and RepVGG-based encoder (P3-P5). Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with a learning rate drop at epochs 60 and 80 (unlike final models which drop at 85). Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: (gnConv+SLIMp2)
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant featuring a slimmed-down GnConv P2 layer (128 channels) for efficient high-resolution feature extraction. Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone and RepVGG-based encoder (P3-P5). Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with a learning rate drop at epochs 60 and 80 (unlike final models which drop at 85). Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: Aware Loss Reweighting
description: Experimental validation run of RT-DETR implementing aware loss reweighting. Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone and RepVGG-based encoder (P3-P5). Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: EfficientNet-B2
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant replacing the ResNet-18vd backbone with EfficientNet-B2 for reduced parameter count. Uses the standard RepVGG-based encoder (P3-P5). Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: EfficientNet-B2+P2
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant replacing the ResNet-18vd backbone with EfficientNet-B2 and adding a standard RepVGG-based P2 feature level for improved small object detection. Uses the standard RepVGG-based encoder (P3-P5). Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: Normal RT-DETR
description: Experimental validation run of the standard RT-DETR model with a ResNet-18vd backbone. Uses the original AIFI-based encoder with 3 CCFM stages (P3-P5 feature levels). Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: P2-P3 fusion
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant replacing the standard CCFM encoder with a simpler P2-P3 feature fusion mechanism for faster inference. Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone. Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: Query IMP
description: Experimental validation run of RT-DETR with scale-aware query selection allocating queries proportionally across feature levels (40% from P3, 30% from P4, 30% from P5) while keeping num_queries at the default 300. Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone and RepVGG-based encoder (P3-P5). Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers.

name: SLIM p2 layer
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant featuring a slimmed-down P2 feature level (128 channels) using a RepVGG-based block for high-resolution small object features. Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone and RepVGG-based encoder (P3-P5). Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 6 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: SLIM p2 layer CRR
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant featuring a slimmed-down RepVGG-based P2 feature level (128 channels). This is the 3-decoder-layer version of the 6-decoder-layer slim P2 model. Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone and RepVGG-based encoder (P3-P5). Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: gnconv
description: Experimental validation run of RT-DETR replacing standard convolutions with GnConv in the CCFM encoder (P3-P5 levels). Uses the original ResNet-18vd backbone. Does not include a P2 layer. Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: gnconv + SLIM p2 layer + Repvgg
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant featuring a slimmed-down RepVGG-based P2 layer (128 channels) combined with a GnConv-based CCFM encoder (P3-P5). Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone. Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 6 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: gnconv + SLIM p2 layer + Repvgg CRR
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant featuring a slimmed-down RepVGG-based P2 layer (128 channels) combined with a GnConv-based CCFM encoder (P3-P5). This is the 3-decoder-layer (CRR) version. Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone. Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: gnconv + p2 layer
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant adding a P2 feature level using GnConv, combined with a GnConv-based CCFM encoder (P3-P5). Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone. Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 6 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: gnconv + p2 layer + Repvgg
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant featuring a RepVGG-based P2 layer added as a high-resolution feature level, combined with a GnConv-based CCFM encoder (P3-P5). Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone. Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 6 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: gnconv + p2 layer + Repvgg CRR
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant featuring a RepVGG-based P2 layer combined with a GnConv-based CCFM encoder (P3-P5). This is the 3-decoder-layer (CRR) version of the 6-decoder experiment. Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone. Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: gnconv + p2 layer CRR
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant adding a P2 feature level using GnConv, combined with a GnConv-based CCFM encoder (P3-P5). This is the 3-decoder-layer (CRR) version. Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone. Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.

name: p2 layer
description: Experimental validation run of the RT-DETR variant featuring a standard RepVGG-based P2 feature block added for enhanced small object detection. Uses the standard ResNet-18vd backbone and default RepVGG-based encoder (P3-P5). Trained on a 9-class subset of VisDrone for 90 epochs, with learning rate drops at epochs 60 and 80. Uses 3 decoder layers with 300 queries.
